description: TokenEconomizer on the GitHub Copilot CLI: inject learned repo facts at session start, guard prompt-turns against failing loops, and fold each finished session into what is learned.

hooks.windows: & { $env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'; $OutputEncoding = [Console]::InputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding; $payload = if ($MyInvocation.ExpectingInput) { $input -join "`n" } else { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; $candidates = @(foreach ($name in @($env:TE_PYTHON, 'python3', 'python', 'py')) { if ($name) { Get-Command $name -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }); $python = $candidates | Where-Object { $_.Source -notlike '*\WindowsApps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $python) { foreach ($candidate in $candidates) { & $candidate.Source -c pass *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $python = $candidate; break } } }; if (-not $python) { $root = if ($env:TOKENECONOMIZER_HOME) { $env:TOKENECONOMIZER_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.tokeneconomizer' }; try { [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($root) | Out-Null; [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $root 'errors.log'), "te: no Python on PATH (set TE_PYTHON)`n") } catch [IO.IOException] { [Console]::Error.WriteLine($_.Exception.Message) } catch [UnauthorizedAccessException] { [Console]::Error.WriteLine($_.Exception.Message) }; '{}'; exit 0 }; $pythonArgs = @(); if ($python.Name -eq 'py.exe' -or $python.Name -eq 'py') { $pythonArgs += '-3' }; $pythonArgs += @((Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\te_bootstrap.py'), 'hook', '--host', 'copilot'); $payload | & $python.Source @pythonArgs; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
